name: Launcher Studio
blurb: Launcher Studio is a modern, native GTK4 application designed to simplify the creation and management of .desktop files on Linux.
description:
Launcher Studio is a modern, native GTK4 application designed to simplify the creation and management of .desktop files on Linux. Whether you need to fix a broken icon or create a shortcut for a standalone AppImage, Launcher Studio provides a powerful yet simple interface.

Key features:

• Basic editor for name, executable path, and icon selection.

• Comprehensive launcher management: Browse, search, and filter user, system (/usr), and Flatpak applications.

• Advanced settings: Categories, Keywords, MimeTypes, and Startup notifications.

• Raw Source View: Inspect and edit the .desktop file content directly.

• Native integration with GNOME and Libadwaita (Dark/Light mode support).

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
